metadata.eval_name: Conway's Game of Life with Emojis

messages.content:
You are an expert JavaScript programmer. Write a single JavaScript function that implements Conway's Game of Life with advanced features.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Function takes a canvas ID parameter (canvas will be 500x500px)
- Renders Conway's Game of Life on the provided canvas
- Uses emojis to represent cells with different emojis for different generations
- Includes famous patterns: Glider, Blinker, Gosper Gun, Pulsar (selectable via dropdown)
- Speed control slider (1-10 generations per second)
- Click-to-toggle cells for custom patterns
- "Randomize" and "Clear" buttons
- Aging system where cells change emojis based on survival time
- Death animation with fade-out effect
- Smooth 60 FPS performance
- No external libraries, works in all major browsers

OUTPUT: Valid JavaScript code only. No explanatory text, comments outside code, or markdown formatting.

function initGameOfLife(canvasId){const canvas=document.getElementById(canvasId);if(!canvas)return;const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');const width=canvas.width;const height=canvas.height;const cellSize=10;const cols=Math.floor(width/cellSize);const rows=Math.floor(height/cellSize);let grid=Array.from({length:rows},()=>Array.from({length:cols},()=>({alive:false,age:0,fade:0})));let nextGrid=Array.from({length:rows},()=>Array.from({length:cols},()=>({alive:false,age:0,fade:0})));const emojis=['🌱','🌿','🌳','🌲','🎄'];const maxFade=500;let lastTime=0;let acc=0;let speed=5;function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.font=`${cellSize-2}px sans-serif`;for(let y=0;y<rows;y++){for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){const cell=grid[y][x];if(cell.alive){let e=emojis[Math.min(emojis.length-1,Math.floor(cell.age/2))];ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.fillText(e,x*cellSize+cellSize/2,y*cellSize+cellSize/2);}else if(cell.fade>0){let e='💀';ctx.globalAlpha=cell.fade/maxFade;ctx.fillText(e,x*cellSize+cellSize/2,y*cellSize+cellSize/2);}}}ctx.globalAlpha=1;}function step(){for(let y=0;y<rows;y++){for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){let alive=grid[y][x].alive;let neighbors=0;for(let dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++){for(let dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++){if(dx===0&&dy===0)continue;let nx=(x+dx+cols)%cols;let ny=(y+dy+rows)%rows;if(grid[ny][nx].alive)neighbors++;}}let next=grid[y][x];if(alive){if(neighbors<2||neighbors>3){next.alive=false;next.age=0;next.fade=maxFade;}else{next.alive=true;next.age=grid[y][x].age+1;next.fade=0;}}else{if(neighbors===3){next.alive=true;next.age=0;next.fade=0;}}nextGrid[y][x]=Object.assign({},next);} }let temp=grid;grid=nextGrid;nextGrid=temp;}function loop(timestamp){if(!lastTime)lastTime=timestamp;let delta=timestamp-lastTime;lastTime=timestamp;acc+=delta;if(acc>=1000/speed){step();acc=0;}draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop);}requestAnimationFrame(loop);function toggleCell(mx,my){const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();const x=Math.floor((mx-rect.left)/cellSize);const y=Math.floor((my-rect.top)/cellSize);if(x<0||x>=cols||y<0||y>=rows)return;let cell=grid[y][x];cell.alive=!cell.alive;cell.age=cell.alive?0:0;cell.fade=cell.alive?0:maxFade;}canvas.addEventListener('click',e=>toggleCell(e.clientX,e.clientY));function clearGrid(){for(let y=0;y<rows;y++)for(let x=0;x<cols;x++)grid[y][x]={alive:false,age:0,fade:0};}function randomize(){for(let y=0;y<rows;y++)for(let x=0;x<cols;x++)grid[y][x]={alive:Math.random()<0.2,age:0,fade:0};}function loadPattern(pattern){clearGrid();const offsetX=Math.floor(cols/2);const offsetY=Math.floor(rows/2);pattern.forEach(([px,py])=>{let x=offsetX+px;let y=offsetY+py;if(x>=0&&x<cols&&y>=0&&y<rows)grid[y][x].alive=true;});}const patterns={Glider:[[1,0],[2,1],[0,2],[1,2],[2,2]],Blinker:[[0,0],[1,0],[2,0]],GosperGun:[[0,4],[0,5],[1,4],[1,5],[10,4],[10,5],[10,6],[11,3],[11,7],[12,2],[12,8],[13,2],[13,8],[14,5],[15,3],[15,4],[15,5],[15,6],[15,7],[16,4],[16,5],[17,5],[20,2],[20,3],[20,4],[21,2],[21,3],[21,4],[22,1],[22,5],[24,0],[24,1],[24,5],[24,6],[34,2],[34,3],[35,2],[35,3]],Pulsar:[[2,0],[3,0],[4,0],[6,0],[7,0],[8,0],[0,2],[5,2],[7,2],[9,2],[0,3],[5,3],[7,3],[9,3],[0,4],[5,4],[7,4],[9,4],[2,5],[3,5],[4,5],[6,5],[7,5],[8,5],[2,7],[3,7],[4,7],[6,7],[7,7],[8,7],[0,9],[5,9],[7,9],[9,9],[0,10],[5,10],[7,10],[9,10],[0,11],[5,11],[7,11],[9,11],[2,12],[3,12],[4,12],[6,12],[7,12],[8,12]]};const ui=document.createElement('div');ui.style.marginTop='10px';const patternSelect=document.createElement('select');Object.keys(patterns).forEach(name=>{const opt=document.createElement('option');opt.value=name;opt.textContent=name;patternSelect.appendChild(opt);});patternSelect.addEventListener('change',e=>loadPattern(patterns[e.target.value]));ui.appendChild(patternSelect);const speedLabel=document.createElement('label');speedLabel.textContent=' Speed:';ui.appendChild(speedLabel);const speedSlider=document.createElement('input');speedSlider.type='range';speedSlider.min='1';speedSlider.max='10';speedSlider.value='5';speedSlider.addEventListener('input',e=>{speed=parseInt(e.target.value,10);});ui.appendChild(speedSlider);const randomBtn=document.createElement('button');randomBtn.textContent='Randomize';randomBtn.onclick=randomize;ui.appendChild(randomBtn);const clearBtn=document.createElement('button');clearBtn.textContent='Clear';clearBtn.onclick=clearGrid;ui.appendChild(clearBtn);canvas.parentNode.insertBefore(ui,canvas.nextSibling);}
